Software Engineer — Remote — US Only

Kaveronix is looking for experienced Software Engineers currently based in the United States for fully remote opportunities with our client organizations.

What we’re looking for:

4+ years of professional software engineering experience Strong experience with modern software development Experience with technologies such as React, Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, TypeScript, or cloud platforms is a plus Strong communication and problem-solving skills Ability to work independently in a remote environment

What we offer:

Fully remote work Flexible working hours Competitive compensation based on experience

Compensation: $80,000–$100,000/year, depending on experience.

If you're interested, please send your resume at hassan.amir@kaveronix.com
